You are the implementation worker for Cross-Harness Skill Implant v1. Your current working directory is a Ringer scratch task directory. Use it only for ./notes.md. The real repository you may edit is /mnt/d_drive/repos/clean-my-ai-harness-mission-fit.

BOUNDARY FIRST: edit only SKILL.md, references/install-upgrade-protocol.md, references/cross-harness-skill-implant.md, assets/implant-manifest.schema.json, assets/implant-request.template.json, scripts/implant_skill.py, scripts/validate_implant_manifest.py, and files under tests/. Do not modify IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md or any other path. Do not edit live roots under ~/.hermes, ~/.claude, ~/.codex, or ~/.gemini. Do not touch .git, commit, push, use network access, install dependencies, run remote commands, restart a runtime, call MCP/Apps, capture to memory, or print environment/secrets.

PURPOSE: implement all five approved Mission Fit recommendations as a deterministic standard-library-only extension of the existing skill package: immutable install plan; target-native discovery gate; one canonical package with link-first behavior; strict separation of inspect from mutation; and one-job/one-goal scope stop. Read /mnt/d_drive/repos/clean-my-ai-harness-mission-fit/IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md, existing SKILL.md, existing references/install-upgrade-protocol.md, and existing code for conventions, but this brief is the authoritative task contract.

LOCKED CLI: (1) python3 scripts/implant_skill.py inspect --request REQUEST.json --manifest MANIFEST.json. (2) python3 scripts/implant_skill.py apply --manifest MANIFEST.json --approval-token sha256:... --backup-root BACKUPS. (3) python3 scripts/implant_skill.py verify --manifest MANIFEST.json --level invoked --allow-executable /absolute/native-cli, where --allow-executable repeats. (4) python3 scripts/implant_skill.py rollback --manifest MANIFEST.json --approval-token sha256:.... (5) python3 scripts/validate_implant_manifest.py MANIFEST.json.

IMMUTABLE MANIFEST: add an implant request template and JSON schema. Inspect reads a request and writes top-level schema_version, plan, plan_hash, status, receipts, events. Plan includes deterministic source tree SHA-256, parsed and expected frontmatter names, source URI/path, exact scope allowed actions and excluded expansions, compatibility status, targets, prior state, link/copy method, collision classification, discovery adapter contract, rollback. Compute sha256 over canonical JSON of plan. Every validator/apply/verify/rollback recomputes it and fails PLAN_HASH_MISMATCH before mutation if changed. Apply and rollback require exact token equality or fail APPROVAL_TOKEN_MISMATCH.

APPLY/ROLLBACK: source is read-only and rehashed before and after. Target roots must already exist. Default is one canonical source plus symlinks. Copy is allowed only when declared and exact parity is recorded. Collision actions are uppercase BLOCK, KEEP, MERGE, REPLACE, RENAME. BLOCK fails COLLISION_BLOCKED. KEEP leaves an existing destination untouched and passes only when it resolves to or exactly matches the approved source. MERGE always stops MERGE_REQUIRES_HUMAN. REPLACE backs up before installing and rollback restores. RENAME leaves the original and uses rename_to, refusing an occupied alternate. Apply is transactional: any failure restores changes from that attempt. Rollback removes only manifest-created targets, restores backups, leaves KEEP untouched, and is idempotent or explicitly already rolled back. Incompatible plans fail INCOMPATIBLE_FRAMEWORK before target mutation.

DISCOVERY: levels are ordered present, indexed, loaded, invoked. Present is built in. Integrity is always separate and checks link identity or copy tree parity. Higher levels require request-supplied adapters with level, argv version_command, version_regex, argv command, success_regex, timeout_seconds. Use subprocess argv with shell=False. The executable for both commands must be explicitly supplied through --allow-executable. Version must match before discovery runs. Store only status, return code, duration, command hash, stdout hash, stderr hash, and version-match result. Never store raw stdout/stderr/output/excerpts. Overall verify fails if required level or integrity fails. Presence true with indexed false must remain red. Do not invent built-in Claude/Codex/Gemini commands; docs explain version-pinned operator-supplied adapters.

REPLAY TESTS: add unittest coverage for clean four-root link install and all levels; existence-only discovery red; executable allowlist red; all five collision actions and rollback; copy drift; incompatible framework; plan tampering; wrong token; sanitized receipts; immutable scope exclusions. The independent Ringer checker at /mnt/d_drive/repos/ringer/work/cross-harness-skill-implant/check_implant_workflow.py is authoritative and may reveal constraints your own tests miss.

DOCS/SKILL: update the current skill rather than creating a second skill. Keep Cleaner installation separate. Require approval of the exact plan hash. Explain inspect/apply/verify/rollback phases, one canonical package, link-first policy, copy parity/drift, four discovery levels, collision actions, sanitized receipts, rollback, and one-job/one-goal stop. Do not include stale or invented native commands.

HOW TO RUN FROM THE REPO ROOT: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v ; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 /mnt/d_drive/repos/ringer/work/cross-harness-skill-implant/check_implant_workflow.py --repo . ; PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/skill-implant-pyc python3 -m py_compile scripts/implant_skill.py scripts/validate_implant_manifest.py. Fix all failures only in owned files.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: leave verified changes in the repository and write ./notes.md in the scratch task directory. notes.md must list files changed, verification commands and exact pass result, the hardest decision, rejected alternatives, and the least-confident assumption. Do not claim live installation or cross-surface discovery. The highest possible state in this task is repository implementation with executed local tests.
